records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Collective!
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly deferred evaluation by a week ([email:94dd996b]), which covers most of the 8 remaining days. No project, no invite, no key milestone at day 6 despite three outreach emails ([email:a176ad71], [email:df5cb7a1], [email:d6b490cc]) and zero tickets, suggesting low engagement rather than blocked setup.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide, and I won't crowd your inbox in the meantime.

One thought for whenever you're ready: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real project in place is usually what makes the comparison concrete. If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a short call this week or next and help you get that first project shaped around how your team actually works — your call on timing.

Best,
Nadia
